title: Page 3
lines: 蓬莱取下那枚沾满口水的代掌门令，仔细将它擦干净后，转过身两手环着胸，阴恻恻地问。
“师妹，你倒是给我说说，前阵子搞得西苑国鸡飞狗跳的小黄书是怎么回事？”
当西苑国皇帝派的那个使者找上门来告状时，哭得那叫一个悲天惨地日月无光啊，都因那薄薄的一本小黄书，月穹就拆散了西苑国的家庭无数，偏偏出钱印书的斐然说皇爷府与此事毫无干系，推得一干又二净，要找就去找黄金门算账，害得他们黄金门不得不替她背起这个大黑锅……
她以为她如今还是鸡嫌狗厌的毛孩子吗？经常就出门招祸惹事，然后让人家怒气冲冲地上门来找家长告状？简直愈活愈回去了！
从没有反省之心的月穹耸耸肩，慢条斯理地解着身上缠了一圈又一圈的粗绳，老早就被人告状告得不痛也不痒。
“为取得魂纸的正当手段。”当时为了取得西苑皇帝偷来的那张魂纸，她不过就是配合了一下斐然的计谋而已，又没干啥天理不容的事。
蓬莱可没被她敷衍过去，“那卖了小黄书的钱呢？”他可没见她上贡入库。
被这一句正正地戳进心坎里的月穹，现在想起来还是怀恨不已。
她忿忿地咬着牙，“被狼宗的师爷给吞了……”她的辛苦血汗钱啊，全为了买那张魂纸而被吃人不吐骨头的奸商给坑了！
蓬莱才不管她如何咬牙切齿，“上回我说过，你要敢再写什么小黄书，我就剁了你的手指是吧？”
“师兄，你不能剥夺我人生的乐趣！”她义正辞严地反驳。
“你的乐趣就是用小黄书祸害世人？”他挑挑眉，如沐春风的笑容看起来愈来愈冰冷。
“话不能这么说，师兄，我虽不常助人行善，但我也很少杀人放火或灭人满门啊，我心中仍是有那一点点正道的！”
“正义之下的歪道？”亏她还敢说得振振有词，眼睛眨也不眨。
“哪有这回事，我明明就是一腔热血……”
“为钱财？”早看透她了。
被堵得一句话都说不出来的月穹瞪着他，还想再开口解释什么时，蓬莱已漾着阴森的笑容轻拍着她的面颊。
“大师兄日前发话了，你要敢再败坏师门的名声，他就亲自动手，让你在门中躺上半年好好反省反省。”
由大师兄亲自动手？
想想往年全师门上下是如何被大师兄打了残、残了又再打的往事，月穹的心当下便嗖嗖嗖地凉了大半截。
“大师兄他对我有歧见，大师兄他偏心！”想当和尚的人思想就是保守加顽固，明明小黄书就是寓教于乐的休闲好读物，世上多少懵懂不知春情如何入门的年轻男女为此感激她呀，偏偏就大师兄那个伪和尚视如洪水猛兽！
“我也这么认为。”蓬莱煞有介事地跟着颔首，“依我看，半年其实是不切实际的。”
“对对对……”急于想逃过一劫的月穹点头如捣蒜。
“因此我会诚恳建议大师兄，非得让你确实躺上个三年五载才是。”光是关她个半年有个屁用？还有，从小到大，腿都不知打断几次了，她在好了后不照样蹦蹦跳跳地跑去外头胡天胡地？既然他这个心慈手软的二师兄老是看不住她，那他就找个更凶残更没人性的来收拾她。
月穹一脸痛心外加捶胸顿足，“煮豆燃豆萁，师兄，你这是相煎何太急！”
蓬莱一本正经，随便她满地撒泼去，“我手痒很久了，师妹，别逼我大义灭亲。”
光她怨而已吗？他也很怨啊。
想当年误入歧途拜错师门的他，误以为黄金门跟江湖上的其他门派一样，不但有着武艺高强的师兄们，门派里还有着温柔体贴，需要师兄们呵护着的师妹们……可是就在他家师父接连收了几个师妹之后，他就不敢再抱有任何过于美好的妄想了。
他想，他上辈子定是砍错仇家杀错人了，不然今世怎会有如此报应？唉，他也不过就是想要有个温柔的软妹子而已，偏偏师父收的师妹们不是虎就是狼，还有月穹这等从不知耻字怎么写的泼皮！这教他情何以堪？
他只是想要一个正常的师妹而已呀……
“二师兄，你找我？”软软甜甜的嗓音，在蓬莱悲愤不已的这当头，宛如压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草，彻底让他的陈年怨念崩溃决堤。
站在书房门边往里头看的再莱，看上去，一如蓬莱当年心中所刻画的美好师妹，不但有着甜美的外表，还有开口就能让人酥了骨头的嫩嗓，更有着……让他从此不想再让师父收什么师妹的野兽本性！
虽然说，外表一点也看不出来。
蓬莱死死地抿住嘴角，反覆吸气又吐气，极力按捺住差点又管不住的手紧握成拳，以免下一刻他的手又会朝再莱那边伸过去，想摸摸一副人畜无害样的她的头。
“小六！”月穹才没管蓬莱心底在挣扎些什么，兴冲冲地就想往那边跑去。
蓬莱眼疾手快地一把将想要趁机开溜的月穹给拎了回来，同时将方才还没确定要给谁的保镖任务塞进再莱的手里。
“这封信你拿去看看。”他像换了个人似的，语气温和地道：“我还有话与你四师姊谈，乖，去外面玩。”
再莱向来就是听话照办的好宝宝，“喔。”
看她一个指令一个动作地乖乖转身关上门，蓬莱心头更是感慨不已。
排行第六的再莱，当年在师父收她入门时，就是个白白嫩嫩呆呆憨憨又特别好哄好骗的三岁乖女娃，整个师门的师兄弟妹们，在得知师父收了她后都因此而乐翻了天。
每日他们在练武之余，只要一有空闲，便轮番上演抢人大战，个个爱不释手地抱着又乖又软的小孩揉揉亲亲，还时常今儿个你陪小孩睡一晚，明儿个轮到我那儿带她一晚，而小孩也没有半点脾气，谁哄谁好，谁抱就跟谁亲，让她叫师兄，她就用软绵绵的嗓音喊师兄，甜得每个人的心头都能滴出几斤蜜……
最后还是大师兄亲自出马，板着脸吓跑了他们这票年纪小小就跟登徒子没两样的师弟妹，并严令把小孩给搁在佛堂那边教养，不然她早就被那票人格没下限的师兄师姊给轻薄光了。
然而就在大师兄亲自看过再莱的根骨后……
“是个难得一见的习武好苗子。”负责教导全师门师弟妹武艺的大师兄下了个结论。
压根就不懂半点武艺的师父大人听得两眼放光，“那……”
“只是她不适合习武。”大师兄又一盆冷水浇灭了所有人的热情。“为何？”蓬莱两手紧抱着在他怀中酣睡的再莱，深怕当家作主的大师兄，下一句话就是将她给逐出师门。
“她呆。”大师兄无奈地戳破每个人都刻意视而不见的问题。
其实蓬莱也早就看出来了，虽然怀中的孩子总是对他们笑得很纯良很无辜，可他们也都没法不去注意到，再莱的反应慢，比寻常的孩子都慢上许多，且一句话要她听懂，她得费力想很久，一件事无论说了几回，她也不见得能够明白，而她之所以每日能笑得如此天真烂漫欢乐无忧，正是因为生来就不足的她，不懂。
精通医术的大师兄淡淡再道：“她虽不是傻子，但天生略有不足。”
“能治好吗？”蓬莱不舍地抱紧了怀中的孩子。
“难。”就算是从小好好调养，也不能弥补她那生来就有的问题。
content_en:
Penglai took off the acting head order that was stained with saliva, wiped it clean carefully, turned around, crossed his arms around his chest, and asked sinisterly.
"Junior sister, please tell me, what happened to the pornographic book that made Xiyuan Country so excited a while ago?"
When the envoy sent by the emperor of Xiyuan Kingdom came to complain, he cried so miserably that the sun and the moon were dim. All because of that thin yellow book, Yue Qiong tore up countless families in Xiyuan Kingdom. However, Feiran, who paid for the printing of the book, said that the emperor's palace had nothing to do with the matter.
Does she think she is still a disgusting child? Do you often go out and cause trouble, and then have people come to your parents' door angrily to complain? I feel more alive and well!
Yue Qiong, who has never had a heart to reflect, shrugged and slowly untied the thick ropes wrapped around his body. He had been sued for a long time and it didn't hurt or itch.
"It's a legitimate means to obtain the soul paper." In order to obtain the soul paper stolen by Emperor Xiyuan, she just cooperated with Fei Ran's plan, and she didn't do anything that was forbidden by nature.
Penglai didn't let her deal with it, "What about the money from selling the pornographic book?" He didn't see her paying tribute and putting it into the treasury.
Yue Qiong, who was deeply pierced into his heart by this sentence, still feels resentful when he thinks about it.
She gritted her teeth angrily, "She was swallowed by the master of the Wolf Sect..." All her hard-earned money was cheated by profiteers who ate people without spitting out their bones just to buy the soul paper!
Penglai didn't care how she gritted her teeth, "I said last time, if you dare to write any pornographic books again, I will chop off your fingers, right?"
"Brother, you can't deprive me of the joy of life!" She retorted righteously.
"Your hobby is to harm the world with pornographic books?" He raised his eyebrows, and his spring-like smile looked increasingly cold.
"You can't say that, senior brother. Although I don't often help people do good deeds, I rarely kill people, set fires, or destroy people. I still have a little bit of righteousness in my heart!"
"Crooked path under justice?" Fortunately, she still dared to speak plausibly without blinking her eyes.
"How could such a thing happen? I am obviously full of passion..."
"For money?" He had already seen through her.
Yue Qiong, who was speechless and unable to speak, stared at him. When she was about to explain something more, Penglai patted her cheek with a sinister smile.
"Elder brother has spoken a few days ago. If you dare to ruin the reputation of our school again, he will take action himself and make you lie in the door for half a year to reflect and reflect."
Is it up to the senior brother to do it himself?
Thinking about the past years, how the whole master was beaten and beaten again by the senior brother, Yue Qiong's heart suddenly felt cold.
"Eldest Brother, he is biased against me, Eldest Brother, he is partial!" People who want to be monks are conservative and stubborn in their thinking. Obviously, pornographic books are good leisure books that are both educational and entertaining. How many young men and women in the world who are ignorant and don't know how to start love are grateful to her for this, but it's just the fake monk, Senior Brother, who treats him like a scourge!
"I think so too." Penglai nodded seriously, "In my opinion, half a year is actually unrealistic."
"Yes, yes..." Yue Qiong, who was eager to escape, nodded like garlic.
"Therefore, I would sincerely suggest to you, senior brother, that you must be allowed to lie down for three to five years." Just locking her up for half a year is of no use? Also, her legs have been broken countless times since she was a child. After she recovered, wouldn't she still jump around and run around outside? Since he, the soft-hearted second senior brother, always couldn't stand her, then he would find someone more cruel and inhumane to deal with her.
Yue Qiong looked distressed and beat her chest and feet, "Boil the beans to burn the pods. Senior brother, why are you in such a hurry!"
Penglai was serious and let her splash all over the floor, "My hands have been itchy for a long time, junior sister, don't force me to kill my relatives out of justice."
Is it just her complaint? He was also very resentful.
Thinking back to the time when he went astray and became a disciple of the wrong disciple, he mistakenly thought that the Golden Sect was like other sects in the world. Not only did they have senior brothers with strong martial arts skills, but there were also gentle and considerate junior sisters who needed the protection of the senior brothers... But after his master accepted several junior sisters one after another, he no longer dared to have any overly beautiful delusions.
He thought that he must have killed the wrong enemy and killed the wrong person in his previous life. Otherwise, how could there be such retribution in this life? Alas, he just wants to have a gentle and soft girl, but the junior sisters that the master accepts are either tigers or wolves, and there are naughty guys like Yue Qiong who never know how to write the word shame! How could this make him feel so embarrassed?
He just wants a normal junior sister...
"Second Senior Brother, are you looking for me?" The soft and sweet voice, when Penglai was filled with grief and anger, was like the last straw that broke the camel's back, completely causing his old resentment to collapse.
Standing by the door of the study and looking inside, Zai Lai looked just like the beautiful junior sister that Penglai had imagined in his mind back then. Not only did he have a sweet appearance, but he also had a tender voice that could make people go numb when he opened his mouth. He also had... a beastly nature that made him never want his master to accept any more junior sisters!
Although, it can't be seen at all from the outside.
Penglai pursed the corners of her mouth tightly, inhaling and exhaling repeatedly, trying her best to hold back the hand that was almost out of control and clenched it into a fist, lest he would reach out to Zai Lai the next moment and want to touch her head, which looked harmless to humans and animals.
"Xiao Liu!" Yue Qiong didn't care what Penglai was struggling in his heart, and wanted to run over there happily.
Penglai quickly picked up Yue Qiong, who wanted to take advantage of the opportunity to escape, and at the same time thrust the undecided bodyguard mission into Zai Lai's hands.
"Take this letter and read it." He said in a gentle tone as if he was a different person: "I still have something to talk to your fourth senior sister, be good and go outside to play."
Zai Lai has always been a good baby who obeys and does as he is told, "Oh."
Watching her obediently turn around and close the door with each movement, Penglai was filled with emotion.
Zai Lai, who is ranked sixth, was a fair, tender, silly, silly and good-looking three-year-old girl who was very easy to coax when the master accepted her into the school. All the brothers and sisters in the school were overjoyed when they learned that the master had accepted her.
Every day after practicing martial arts, as long as they have free time, they will take turns to stage a robbery battle. Each one of them can't put it down, hugging the well-behaved and soft child, kneading and kissing it. They will often sleep with the child one night today, and it will be the other's turn tomorrow. I took her there for one night, and the child didn't have any temper at all. She would coax whoever she liked, and kiss whomever she hugged. When I asked her to call her senior brother, she called him senior brother in a soft voice. It was so sweet that everyone's heart could drip with kilograms of honey...
In the end, it was the eldest brother who personally took action, and with a straight face, he scared away these juniors and sisters who were no different from young disciples, and strictly ordered the child to be educated in the Buddhist hall, otherwise she would have been scorned by those senior brothers and sisters who had no lower limit of personality.
However, after the senior brother saw Zai Lai's bones in person...
"He is a rare young man who is good at practicing martial arts." The senior brother who is responsible for teaching martial arts to all his juniors came to a conclusion.
Master, who didn't know any martial arts at all, his eyes lit up when he heard this, "Then..."
"It's just that she's not suitable for practicing martial arts." The senior brother poured out another basin of cold water to dampen everyone's enthusiasm. "Why?" Penglai held Zai Lai, who was sleeping soundly in his arms, tightly with both hands. He was deeply afraid that his senior brother, who was in charge of the family, would expel her from the school in his next words.
"She's stupid." The senior brother helplessly exposed the problem that everyone was deliberately turning a blind eye to.
In fact, Penglai had noticed it a long time ago. Although the children in her arms always smiled innocently and innocently at them, they couldn't help but notice that Zai Lai's reaction was slow, much slower than that of ordinary children, and for her to understand a sentence, she had to think hard for a long time. No matter how many times she said something, she might not be able to understand it. And the reason why she could smile so innocently, joyfully and carefree every day was precisely because she was born with a lack of understanding.
The senior brother who was proficient in medical skills said calmly: "Although she is not a fool, she is born with some shortcomings."
"Can it be cured?" Penglai reluctantly hugged the child in her arms.
"It's difficult." Even if she has been well cared for since childhood, it cannot make up for the problems she was born with.
